## Application summary
The applicant is a first-time buyer seeking a 402000.0 EUR loan for a 3-bedroom semi-D in Cork. The asking price for the property is 474000.0 EUR.

## Affordability
The affordability rating is adequate. Spare income is thin once rates rise 2 points.

## Property assessment
The valuation rating is adequate. The asking price of 474000.0 EUR is 12.01% above the model estimate of 423174.57 EUR, and the model LTV of 95.0% exceeds the 90% limit.

## Market context
The ECB main refinancing rate is 2.15% and the Irish new mortgage rate is 3.9%. The outlook for interest rates remains on an upward trajectory due to energy-driven inflation.

## Disagreements
The Affordability agent recommends Approve, while the Valuation agent recommends Conditionally Approve. I side with the Valuation agent because the model LTV of 95.0% exceeds the 90% limit, necessitating risk mitigation.

## Recommendation and conditions
I recommend a conditional approval. The applicant must obtain an independent surveyor's valuation and reduce the loan amount to bring the model LTV within the 90% limit.
